snippet.title: FOUNTAINS - Pre-Order Trailer | Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, PC
snippet.description:
FOUNTAINS, the genre-bending soulslike/metroidvania mix storms Xbox Series X|S and Nintendo Switch on 🗓️September 17th🗓️

The console versions launch alongside the brand-new Shattered Shape DLC, bringing new foes, new weapons and new lands shrouded in mystery.
